name: Fruit Match Salon
summary:
Dive into a juicy and colorful world with Fruit Match Salon! Designed exclusively for virtual reality, this delightful match-3 puzzle game combines classic fruit-swapping mechanics with an immersive 3D environment, charming animations, and relaxing gameplay.
